task_summary: I am a software architect. I need to review the overall organization of the system before planning its future evolution. I want to understand the main architectural components, their responsibilities, how the system is decomposed into different layers or subsystems, and the main dependencies among them. I also need to identify how user-facing functionality, application logic, domain entities, and data persistence are separated and how these parts collaborate to provide the main system functionalities. | review the overall organization of the system before planning its future evolution | overall organization of the system | The diagram must make clear the main architectural components, their responsibilities, how the system is decomposed into different layers or subsystems, the main dependencies among them, and how user-facing functionality, application logic, domain entities, and data persistence are separated and collaborate.

selected_view.purpose: Module Decomposition View for overall organization system: modules or subsystems that own the task, named by responsibility. Relations: containment or uses. Do not: one box per source file; class inventory.
selected_view.diagram_language_rule: viewpoint agent chose plantuml: PlantUML accurately structures the hierarchical modules, subsystems, layers, and their containment relationships as required by the questions.

required_information.need: module that owns overall organization of the system

architectural_questions.text: What are the main architectural components and their assigned responsibilities within the overall organization of the system?
How is the overall organization of the system decomposed into different layers or subsystems?
What are the main dependencies among the components, layers, and subsystems in the overall organization of the system?
How do user-facing functionality, application logic, domain entities, and data persistence separate and collaborate within the overall organization of the system?
